<<Cleaning A Telescope Mirror, Briefly>>

Regular cleaning of telescope mirrors is essential to maintain optimal viewing performance. Use a soft, lint-free cloth or a gentle cleaning solution to wipe away dust, dirt, and fingerprints. Avoid using abrasive materials or harsh chemicals that could scratch the mirror surface. Always work in a clean, dust-free environment. Clean the mirror after each use and before observing celestial objects. This ensures clear, sharp images and a better viewing experience for all.
